references.text: Moses gathers all the elders and officials of the tribes to speak to them, similar to the gathering of all Israel described in Deuteronomy 29:9
Joshua gathers all the tribes of Israel with their leaders, judges, and officials before the Lord, just as Moses did in Deuteronomy 29:9
The people are presented before God at the foot of Mount Sinai, a parallel to how Israel stands before the Lord in Deuteronomy 29:9
Describes the appointment of leaders, chiefs, and officials over the tribes, as mentioned in Deuteronomy 29:9
Refers to the heads and elders of the tribes who came to Moses, similar to the leadership structure in Deuteronomy 29:9
Mentions the leaders and heads of the tribes in Israel, corresponding to the leadership described in Deuteronomy 29:9
Moses chooses capable men as leaders and officials over the people, a parallel to the leadership structure in Deuteronomy 29:9
